hero.title: About 4stax Labs
hero.subtitle: Sri Lankan Software. Built Around Real Business Operations.
hero.description: 4stax Labs is a Sri Lankan software development company building enterprise applications and SaaS platforms that simplify workforce and business operations. We combine product thinking, practical engineering, and close client collaboration to deliver secure, scalable solutions across web, desktop, mobile, and cloud environments—designed around how teams actually work.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: A focused journey from a small software team to a trusted enterprise technology partner.
content: 4stax Labs was founded in 2020 with a clear idea: business software should adapt to the way people work, not force teams into rigid processes. We started by solving practical operational problems with thoughtful, maintainable software.

Since then, we have partnered with more than 10 companies, delivering solutions across workforce management, business operations, web platforms, cloud systems, and custom applications. Each project has strengthened our ability to turn complex requirements into simple, dependable digital experiences.

Today, our 12-member team continues to grow through hands-on delivery, close client collaboration, and a strong engineering mindset. We remain intentionally practical—building secure, scalable products that create measurable value without unnecessary complexity.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To simplify complex workforce and business operations through dependable software that is intuitive to use, secure by design, and built to create lasting operational value.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To become one of Sri Lanka's most trusted enterprise software and SaaS partners, known for practical innovation, engineering quality, and solutions that grow with the businesses behind them.

values.title: Practical Innovation
values.description: We use technology with purpose—choosing the right approach for the problem rather than complexity for its own sake.

values.title: Engineering Excellence
values.description: We care about reliability, maintainability, security, and the small implementation details that make software last.

values.title: Trusted Partnership
values.description: We communicate clearly, work transparently, and treat client goals and constraints as part of the product problem.

values.title: Built Together
values.description: We collaborate closely across disciplines and with clients so decisions are informed, useful, and grounded in reality.

culture.title: A Culture Built for Good Work
culture.description: We keep our environment focused, collaborative, and low on unnecessary process—giving people room to think deeply, take ownership, share ideas, and continuously improve how we build.

highlights.title: Ownership Over Hierarchy
highlights.description: Ideas can come from anywhere. Team members are encouraged to take responsibility, challenge assumptions, and improve the outcome.

highlights.title: Deep Work Friendly
highlights.description: We value focused engineering time, clear communication, and sensible processes that protect attention instead of creating noise.

highlights.title: Learn, Share, Improve
highlights.description: New tools, better patterns, and lessons from delivery are shared across the team so each project makes the next one stronger.

highlights.title: People Before Process
highlights.description: We aim for a sustainable working rhythm where accountability, flexibility, respect, and quality can coexist.

cta.title: Build Something Practical With Us
cta.description: If you are planning a workforce platform, enterprise application, SaaS product, or custom system, we would be glad to understand the problem and explore the right way to build it.
